ideas.title: Land yacht with a dynamo on its axle: today's wind becomes tonight's drive
ideas.goal: The player sails the bare cart along the beach with the friends aboard, trimming a patched sail against the wind (too tight: the flow tears off and it stalls; too loose: it luffs; just right: it heels onto two wheels and runs faster than the wind on a reach). The axle turns Lumi's motor run backwards as a dynamo into the clay-pot cells: switch the dynamo in and it brakes the cart and charges; switch it out and the cart flies. Every afternoon is a trade between speed now and charge for the evening, when the wind drops, the sail comes down and the same motor drives the cart home on what the sailing stored. Reading the wind, the sail and the charge is the skill, and no two days are alike because the wind is not.
ideas.toward: Two road steps at once, in the cart itself: 'the motor run backwards: a generator' (the drum motor from motor.jl on the cart's axle, back EMF and real coil current, charging cells) and 'wheels, axle and frame in sand with the friends aboard'; it is the big goal's 'cart that runs on yesterday's wind' in its first honest form: the wind that moved it is the charge that drives it.
ideas.idea: No lift curve: the sail is cloth (PrintSim VBD) and an immersed body in a 3D WaterLily box that rides with the cart on the GPU (5 ms a step since this session's Lava fix); the solved pressure on each panel is the cloth's force, its new shape the next body in the flow, so stall, luffing and the slot come out of the flow. The mast carries the force to the rigid frame, the wheels roll by wheelsand.jl (wet hard sand vs soft dry, sinkage), the cart heels when the heeling moment beats the friends' weight; the axle drives the drum motor through a belt as a generator (motor.jl, emf from the rotor speed in the stone field), its current through circuit.jl into the pot cells (potcell.jl), and its back torque is the brake the player feels. Watching: a wooden cart with a patched sail tearing along the waterline, the cloth bellying, a wheel lifting, friends leaning out; then the dynamo switched in, the commutator sparking, the cart slowing hard; at dusk the sail down and the cart creaking home under its own motor.
ideas.form: A plugin on the south beach with the cart assets (plank, board wheels), Jump in to steer, trim (mouse = sheet) and switch the dynamo; a path traced film from a low tracking camera beside the lifting wheel, the sail filling the upper frame, then the dusk drive home.

ideas.title: Heave: the friends' feet move the stuck cart, and the sand remembers every try
ideas.goal: The cart has run off the last plank and stands nose down in soft sand. The player places the friends (behind, at the wheels, on a rope in front) and Lumi pushes too, by the player's own key timing; each friend pushes as hard as its feet hold. A failed heave digs the ruts deeper and builds the berm higher, so the same trick does not work twice: next try needs a plank shoved under a wheel, a friend moved to dry sand, or rocking it backwards first. It is a new little puzzle every time the road ends, because the sand is never the same.
ideas.toward: The road's step 'wheels, axle and frame on a plank track and in sand; the friends push it', with every push from real masses and real traction.
ideas.idea: Nothing is a threshold: the stop is the bulldozing and compaction resistance of the wheel in the sand field (wheelsand.jl, sinkage written into sandfield.jl so ruts and berm grow with each try); each friend's push is the traction its feet get under its real weight (foot_creep, #745), feet that slip dig holes; the cart is a rigid body rocking in its rut, so timing is the physics. Watching: three pony-sized friends straining against a wooden cart, sand spraying from their feet, the cart rocking, lurching over the berm, a friend falling flat as it goes.
ideas.form: A plugin at the end of the plank road on the dune; Jump in to place friends and heave; a traced film low beside the wheel.
